title.zh: 参议院民主党人在新报告中称Tether是伊朗政权的“生命线”
title.en: Tether is a ‘lifeline’ for Iranian regime, Senate Dems say in new report

current_state.zh: 参议院民主党人发布报告指控Tether的USDT为伊朗制裁规避网络提供‘金融生命线’；同一天，Tether回应称已协助冻结近5.5亿美元与伊朗相关的USDT，并指出参议院少数派报告发现USDT占所研究的846个伊朗及代理相关钱包活动的84%。
current_state.en: Senate Democrats published a report alleging Tether's USDT is a 'financial lifeline' for Iran's sanctions-evading network; the same day, Tether responded that it helped freeze nearly $550 million in Iran-linked USDT, while the Senate minority report found USDT accounted for 84% of activity in 846 Iran- and proxy-linked wallets studied.
